title: Surat Di Belakang Dail
genre: Romanian lautari taraf folk dance (hora lenta to sirba)
subject: a radio repairman in Taiping opens an old Philips valve radio and finds a 1974 love letter behind the dial, then spends the evening tracing its owner by the shop stamp on the back
caption: Romanian lautari taraf village dance, slow hora into a quickening sirba. Lead violin with ornamented slides and double-stop drones, accordion chords and trills, cimbalom tremolo rolls, plucked double bass on the beat. Live acoustic room, dry close-miked, no reverb wash. Male baritone, warm mid register, sung storytelling. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, D minor. Wistful then warming mood. No pop beat, no electronic drums, no autotune, no synths, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - solo violin slides over cimbalom tremolo]

[Verse 1]
Pak Rahim buka belakang radio
Habuk lama jatuh atas meja
Valve dah mati, wayar pun layu
Ada sampul kuning terselit di dalam

[Pre-Chorus]
Dakwat pudar, tulisan tangan
Tahun tujuh puluh empat

[Chorus]
Surat di belakang dail, siapa punya
Cap kedai Taiping di belakang radio
Dia baca perlahan, sambil pasang lampu
Malam ini juga dia nak cari tuannya

[Verse 2]
Dia tanya kedai kopi, tanya tukang jam
Mak Cik Zainab geleng, tapi senyum
Ada nama Halimah di lorong sebelah
Rumah papan, tingkap masih terbuka

[Bridge - accordion and cimbalom alone]
Tangan dia menggigil pegang sampul
Dia ketuk pintu, jantung berdegup

[Chorus]
Surat di belakang dail, ini dia punya
Cap kedai Taiping di belakang radio
Halimah baca perlahan, sambil pegang dada
Malam ini radio itu berbunyi semula

[Outro - violin and accordion slow to a held chord]
Radio berbunyi semula
